title: Mine (Standard)
description: Hypnosis is the only weapon where the more you know about it, the more effective it is against you. In this file I am telling you, logically guiding you to the only conclusion... Every time you listen to me you start out by pretending... playing along. Some of you go into trance when I say the triggers, or lead you there with an induction. Some of you just play along the whole time... or just part of the time. In this file I make you realize that pretending and playing along lead to the same result as falling into trance - you are here, listening and obeying me. Mine. This file is on the purer side of hypnosis, using a confusion induction to catch your mind off balance and quickly take you down into a spiralling of logic and loss of control. Not very overtly sexual, this file is about my control over you, and the conditioning you are a willing participant in.
author: Mistress Shibby
